title: stage open email visibility
context: Year 1 Volume 4 first-year shipboard Zodiac/VIP test. Primary actor action only, gated by personal knowledge at scene time.
observed_actions: Supports Hamaguchi's proposal to volunteer authentic VIP-notification emails, reaches for her phone and prepares to join the display; Kiyotaka intervenes before she reveals its contents.
observed_result: Hamaguchi and Beppu display their notifications, then Kiyotaka presents another device first. Ichinose's own email is not shown in this passage.
epistemic_limits: Source PDF pp.218–220 explicitly says Kiyotaka interrupts before Ichinose can show her email. Never credit her with a completed phone disclosure or confirmed VIP status.
information_available: No unearned actor memories from later reveals, private confessions, other groups or alternate future timelines.
counterfactual_test: Change actor knowledge, physical context, privileges and incentives; allow failures. Do not treat violent or sexual coercion as required, endorsed or reliable.
